closures.risk: The Beijing host had no installed openreel-backup.service.
closures.resolution: Installed the reviewed service and timer from the accepted immutable release, enabled the persistent daily timer, ran a real backup, and verified it into a fresh isolated restore directory.
closures.incident: The first service run failed closed because a historical reconcile-backup directory was mixed into the live publishing-state root. It was moved intact to /var/backups/openreel/publishing-state-reconcile-backup-20260821T1441Z before retry; no data was deleted.

closures.risk: Commercial evaluation uses a stricter CNY 0.10 per-call ceiling than the Ark route global maximum.
closures.resolution: The production configuration and runtime use the same reviewed CNY 0.10 ceiling. This is a deliberate fail-closed budget control rather than unresolved exposure; costs above the confirmed ceiling are rejected.

closures.risk: The shared OpenReel worktree contains pre-existing owner changes.
closures.resolution: The deployed bytes remain isolated from the shared worktree by the accepted immutable 105-artifact release manifest. Current production resolves to that reviewed release and passed a fresh readiness check; no owner change was cleaned, overwritten, or folded into this risk closure.
